f.title: Do not report corrections or removals that are exempt actions
f.statement: Actions taken by device manufacturers or importers to improve the performance or quality of a device that do not reduce a risk to health posed by the device or remedy a violation of the act caused by the device are exempt from the part 806 reporting requirements.

rows.quote:
(b) The following actions are exempt
from the reporting requirements of this
part:
(1) Actions taken by device manufacturers or importers to improve the performance or quality of a device but
that do not reduce a risk to health
posed by the device or remedy a violation of the act caused by the device.

f.title: Note the exemption of market withdrawals, routine servicing and stock recoveries
f.statement: Market withdrawals as defined in 806.2(i), routine servicing as defined in 806.2(l) and stock recoveries as defined in 806.2(m) are exempt from the part 806 reporting requirements.

rows.quote:
(2) Market withdrawal as defined in
§ 806.2(i)
(3) Routine servicing as defined in
§ 806.2(l).
(4) Stock recovery as defined in
§ 806.2(m).

f.title: Apply the definition of "correction"
f.statement: Correction means the repair, modification, adjustment, relabeling, destruction or inspection (including patient monitoring) of a device without its physical removal from its point of use to some other location.

rows.quote:
(d) Correction means the repair, modification, adjustment, relabeling, destruction, or inspection (including patient monitoring) of a device without
its physical removal from its point of
use to some other location.

f.title: Apply the definition of "manufacturer", including repackagers, relabelers and specification developers
f.statement: Manufacturer means any person who manufactures, prepares, propagates, compounds, assembles or processes a device, including any person who repackages or relabels a device, initiates specifications for devices manufactured by a second party, or manufactures ready-to-use components or accessories that are devices. Importer means any person who imports a device into the United States.

rows.quote:
(g) Importer means, for the purposes
of this part, any person who imports a
device into the United States.
(h) Manufacturer means any person
who manufactures, prepares, propagates, compounds, assembles, or processes a device by chemical, physical,
biological, or other procedures. The
term includes any person who:
(1) Repackages or otherwise changes
the container, wrapper, or labeling of a
device in furtherance of the distribution of the device from the original
place of manufacture to the person who
makes final delivery or sale to the ultimate user or consumer;
(2) Initiates specifications for devices
that are manufactured by a second
party for subsequent distribution by
the person initiating the specifications; or
(3) Manufactures components or accessories which are devices that are
ready to be used and are intended to be

f.title: Apply the definition of "market withdrawal"
f.statement: Market withdrawal means a correction or removal of a distributed device that involves a minor violation of the act that would not be subject to legal action by FDA, or that involves no violation of the act (e.g. normal stock rotation practices).

rows.quote:
(i) Market withdrawal means a correction or removal of a distributed device
that involves a minor violation of the
act that would not be subject to legal
action by FDA or that involves no violation of the act, e.g., normal stock rotation practices.

f.title: Apply the definition of "removal"
f.statement: Removal means the physical removal of a device from its point of use to some other location for repair, modification, adjustment, relabeling, destruction or inspection.

rows.quote:
(j) Removal means the physical removal of a device from its point of use
to some other location for repair,
modification, adjustment, relabeling,
destruction, or inspection.

f.title: Apply the definition of "risk to health"
f.statement: Risk to health means a reasonable probability that use of or exposure to the product will cause serious adverse health consequences or death, or that use of or exposure to the product may cause temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences, or an outcome where the probability of serious adverse health consequences is remote.

rows.quote:
(k) Risk to health means
(1) A reasonable probability that use
of, or exposure to, the product will
cause serious adverse health consequences or death; or
(2) That use of, or exposure to, the
product may cause temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences, or an outcome where the
probability of serious adverse health
consequences is remote.

f.title: Apply the definition of "routine servicing"
f.statement: Routine servicing means regularly scheduled maintenance of a device, including replacement of parts at the end of their normal life expectancy (e.g. calibration, battery replacement, responses to normal wear and tear); repairs of an unexpected nature, early replacement of parts, or identical repairs or replacements of multiple units are not routine servicing.

rows.quote:
(l) Routine servicing means any regularly scheduled maintenance of a device, including the replacement of
parts at the end of their normal life expectancy, e.g., calibration, replacement of batteries, and responses to
normal wear and tear. Repairs of an
unexpected nature, replacement of
parts earlier than their normal life expectancy, or identical repairs or replacements of multiple units of a device are not routine servicing.

f.title: Apply the definition of "stock recovery"
f.statement: Stock recovery means the correction or removal of a device that has not been marketed or has not left the direct control of the manufacturer, where no portion of the lot, model, code or other relevant unit involved has been released for sale or use.

rows.quote:
(m) Stock recovery means the correction or removal of a device that has
not been marketed or that has not left
the direct control of the manufacturer,
i.e., the device is located on the premises owned, or under the control of, the
manufacturer, and no portion of the
lot, model, code, or other relevant unit
involved in the corrective or removal
action has been released for sale or use.

f.title: Report to FDA any correction or removal initiated to reduce a risk to health or remedy a violation presenting a risk
f.statement: Each device manufacturer or importer shall submit a written report to FDA of any correction or removal of a device it initiated to reduce a risk to health posed by the device, or to remedy a violation of the act caused by the device which may present a risk to health, unless the information has already been provided as set forth in 806.10(f) or the action is exempt under 806.1(b).
f.exceptions: Information already provided under 806.10(f) (reported under part 803 or 1004); actions exempt under 806.1(b)

rows.quote:
(a) Each device manufacturer or importer shall submit a written report to
FDA of any correction or removal of a
device initiated by such manufacturer
or importer if the correction or removal was initiated:
(1) To reduce a risk to health posed
by the device; or
(2) To remedy a violation of the act
caused by the device which may
present a risk to health unless the information has already been provided as
set forth in paragraph (f) of this section or the corrective or removal action is exempt from the reporting requirements under § 806.1(b).

f.title: Submit the correction or removal report within 10 working days of initiating it
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall submit any report required by 806.10(a) within 10 working days of initiating the correction or removal.

rows.deadline: Within 10 working days of initiating the correction or removal
rows.quote:
(b) The manufacturer or importer
shall submit any report required by
paragraph (a) of this section within 10working days of initiating such correction or removal.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Reports of corrections and removals under 806.10(a)

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: the report number
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report the report number: the seven-digit registration number of the entity responsible for the report (if applicable), the month, day and year of the report, a sequence number (001, 002, ...) and the report type designation "C" or "R".

rows.quote:
(1) The seven digit registration number of the entity responsible for submission of the report of corrective or
removal action (if applicable), the
month, day, and year that the report is
made, and a sequence number (i.e., 001
for the first report, 002 for the second
report, 003 etc.), and the report type
designation ‘‘C’’ or ‘‘R’’.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: firm and responsible representative contact details
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report the name, address and telephone number of the manufacturer or importer, and the name, title, address and telephone number of the representative responsible for conducting the correction or removal.

rows.quote:
(2) The name, address, and telephone
number of the manufacturer or importer, and the name, title, address,
and telephone number of the manufacturer or importer representative responsible for conducting the device
correction or removal.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: device names and intended use
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report the brand name and the common, classification or usual name of the device and its intended use.

rows.quote:
(3) The brand name and the common
name, classification name, or usual
name of the device and the intended
use of the device.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: marketing status and listing number
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report the marketing status of the device (premarket notification or approval number, or preamendments status) and the device listing number; a firm without an FDA establishment registration number shall state whether it has ever registered with FDA.

rows.quote:
(4) Marketing status of the device,
i.e., any applicable premarket notification number, premarket approval number, or indication that the device is a
preamendments device, and the device
listing number. A manufacturer or importer that does not have an FDA establishment registration number shall
indicate in the report whether it has
ever registered with FDA.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: UDI or other device and lot/serial identifiers
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report the UDI on the device label or package, or the device identifier, UPC, model, catalog or code number and the manufacturing lot or serial number or other identification number.

rows.quote:
(5) The unique device identifier (UDI)
that appears on the device label or on
the device package, or the device identifier, universal product code (UPC),
model, catalog, or code number of the
device and the manufacturing lot or serial number of the device or other identification number.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: the manufacturer details if different from the submitter
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report the manufacturer's name, address, telephone number and contact person if different from the person submitting the report.

rows.quote:
(6) The manufacturer’s name, address, telephone number, and contact
person if different from that of the person submitting the report.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: the event and corrective or removal actions
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report a description of the event(s) giving rise to the information reported and the corrective or removal actions that have been and are expected to be taken.

rows.quote:
(7) A description of the event(s) giving rise to the information reported
and the corrective or removal actions
that have been, and are expected to be
taken.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: illnesses or injuries and MDR numbers
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report any illness or injuries that have occurred with use of the device, including the medical device report numbers if applicable.

rows.quote:
(8) Any illness or injuries that have
occurred with use of the device. If applicable, include the medical device report numbers.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: number of devices affected
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report the total number of devices manufactured or distributed subject to the correction or removal and the number in the same batch, lot or equivalent unit of production.

rows.quote:
(9) The total number of devices manufactured or distributed subject to the
correction or removal and the number
in the same batch, lot, or equivalent
unit of production subject to the correction or removal.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: manufacture or distribution date and expiry or expected life
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report the date of manufacture or distribution and the device's expiration date or expected life.

rows.quote:
(10) The date of manufacture or distribution and the device’s expiration
date or expected life.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: all domestic and foreign consignees
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report the names, addresses and telephone numbers of all domestic and foreign consignees and the dates and number of devices distributed to each.

rows.quote:
(11) The names, addresses, and telephone numbers of all domestic and foreign consignees of the device and the
dates and number of devices distributed to each such consignee.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: copies of all communications and their recipients
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report a copy of all communications regarding the correction or removal and the names and addresses of all recipients not provided under (c)(11).

rows.quote:
(12) A copy of all communications regarding the correction or removal and
the names and addresses of all recipients of the communications not provided in accordance with paragraph
(c)(11) of this section.

f.title: Include in the correction/removal report: why information is unavailable and when it will follow
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall include in the correction or removal report if any required information is not immediately available, a statement of why it is not available and when it will be submitted.

rows.quote:
(13) If any required information is
not immediately available, a statement as to why it is not available and
when it will be submitted.

f.title: Amend the report within 10 working days when extending the correction or removal to more lots or batches
f.statement: If, after submitting a report, a manufacturer or importer determines that the same correction or removal should be extended to additional lots or batches of the same device, it shall, within 10 working days of initiating the extension, amend the report by submitting an amendment citing the original report number, all information required by 806.10(c)(2), and any information required by (c)(3) through (c)(12) that differs from the original report.

rows.deadline: Within 10 working days of initiating the extension
rows.quote:
(d) If, after submitting a report under
this part, a manufacturer or importer
determines that the same correction or
removal should be extended to additional lots or batches of the same device, the manufacturer or importer
shall within 10-working days of initiating the extension of the correction or
removal, amend the report by submitting an amendment citing the original
report number assigned according to
paragraph (c)(1) of this section, all of
the information required by paragraph
(c)(2), and any information required by
paragraphs (c)(3) through (c)(12) of this
section that is different from the information submitted in the original report.

deadline_rule.clock_start: initiating the extension of the correction or removal
deadline_rule.applies_to: Amendments extending a reported correction or removal to additional lots or batches

f.title: Explain in the amendment any required information that is not readily available
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall also provide a statement in accordance with 806.10(c)(13) for any required information that is not readily available.

rows.quote:
The manufacturer or importer
shall also provide a statement in accordance with paragraph (c)(13) of this
section for any required information
that is not readily available.

f.title: A correction or removal report is not an admission of causation; the firm may deny it
f.statement: A report submitted under 806.10 (and any FDA release of it) does not necessarily reflect a conclusion that it constitutes an admission that the device caused or contributed to a death or serious injury; a manufacturer or importer need not admit, and may deny, that it does.

rows.quote:
(e) A report submitted by a manufacturer or importer under this section
(and any release by FDA of that report
or information) does not necessarily reflect a conclusion by the manufacturer,
importer, or FDA that the report or information constitutes an admission
that the device caused or contributed
to a death or serious injury. A manu-

facturer or importer need not admit,
and may deny, that the report or information submitted under this section
constitutes an admission that the device caused or contributed to a death
or serious injury.

f.title: No separate correction or removal report is needed if it was reported under part 803 or 1004
f.statement: No report of correction or removal is required under part 806 if a report of the correction or removal is required and has been submitted under part 803 or 1004.

rows.quote:
(f) No report of correction or removal
is required under this part, if a report
of the correction or removal is required
and has been submitted under parts 803
or 1004 of this chapter.

f.title: Keep a record of each correction or removal that does not need an FDA report
f.statement: Each device manufacturer or importer who initiates a correction or removal of a device that is not required to be reported to FDA under 806.10 shall keep a record of it.
f.clause: § 806.20(a) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported.

rows.quote:
(a) Each device manufacturer or importer who initiates a correction or removal of a device that is not required
to be reported to FDA under § 806.10
shall keep a record of such correction
or removal.
rows.location: § 806.20(a) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported.

f.title: Record device identification, event description and actions for unreported corrections and removals
f.statement: Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported shall contain the brand, common or usual name, classification name and product code (if known) and intended use; the UDI or other device identifier and lot or serial number; a description of the event(s) and the corrective or removal action taken and expected; and a copy of all communications regarding the correction or removal.
f.clause: § 806.20(b) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported.

rows.quote:
(b) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported to FDA
under § 806.10 shall contain the following information:
(1) The brand name, common or usual
name, classification, name and product
code if known, and the intended use of
the device.
(2) The unique device identifier (UDI)
of the device, or the device identifier,
universal product code (UPC), model,
catalog, or code number of the device
and the manufacturing lot or serial
number of the device or other identification number.
(3) A description of the event(s) giving rise to the information reported
and the corrective or removal action
that has been, and is expected to be
taken.
(4) Justification for not reporting the
correction or removal action to FDA,
which shall contain conclusions and
any followups, and be reviewed and
evaluated by a designated person.
(5) A copy of all communications regarding the correction or removal.
rows.location: § 806.20(b) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported.

f.title: Justify, with conclusions and follow-ups reviewed by a designated person, not reporting a correction or removal
f.statement: The record shall contain the justification for not reporting the correction or removal action to FDA, which shall contain conclusions and any followups and be reviewed and evaluated by a designated person.
f.clause: § 806.20(b)(4) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported.

rows.quote:
(4) Justification for not reporting the
correction or removal action to FDA,
which shall contain conclusions and
any followups, and be reviewed and
evaluated by a designated person.
rows.location: § 806.20(b)(4) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported.

f.title: Retain unreported correction and removal records for 2 years beyond the expected life of the device
f.statement: The manufacturer or importer shall retain records required under 806.20 for 2 years beyond the expected life of the device, even if it has ceased to manufacture or import the device.
f.clause: § 806.20(c) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported.

rows.deadline: 2 years beyond the expected life of the device (retention)
rows.quote:
(c) The manufacturer or importer
shall retain records required under this
section for a period of 2 years beyond
the expected life of the device, even if
the manufacturer or importer has
ceased to manufacture or import the
device.
rows.location: § 806.20(c) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported.

f.title: Transfer unreported correction and removal records to a new manufacturer or importer
f.statement: Records required under 806.20(b) must be transferred to the new manufacturer or importer of the device and maintained for the required period.
f.clause: § 806.20(c) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported.

rows.quote: Records required to be maintained under paragraph (b) of this section must be transferred to the new
rows.location: § 806.20(c) Records of corrections and removals not required to be reported.

f.title: Permit FDA to access, copy and verify correction and removal records and reports
f.statement: Each device manufacturer or importer required to maintain records under part 806, and every person in charge or custody of them, shall, upon request of a designated FDA officer or employee under section 704(e) of the act, permit access to, and copying and verification of, such records and reports at all reasonable times.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Device manufacturer or importer; person in charge or custody of the records
rows.quote:
Each device manufacturer or importer required under this part to
maintain records and every person who
is in charge or custody of such records
shall, upon request of an officer or employee designated by FDA and under
section 704(e) of the act, permit such
officer or employee at all reasonable
times to have access to, and to copy
and verify, such records and reports.
